variants.name: Cyberdream — existing palette
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Edit target: supplied customized macOS desktop screenshot. Preserve the entire window arrangement, approximate sizes, font scale, modern end-4-inspired rounded corner shapes, native tiny macOS traffic lights, slim top bar, terminal/editor/browser windows, summoned launcher, separate small music/audio popups, and visible broad scarlet sculptural wallpaper. This is a COMPUTER desktop theme concept, not a web application, product page or dashboard. No app Dock, app rail, bottom shelf, device frame, annotations or title labels outside the screenshot. Windows are manually arranged; no automatic tiling implied. Keep opaque readable work surfaces and clean soft offset shadows; no artificial glowing panel outlines or purple/pastel/sepia cast. The original scarlet-and-cyan atmosphere must remain strong. Keep red overwhelmingly the dominant chromatic identity and cyan as the secondary highlight; other colors are reserved for small syntax tokens. Wallpaper stays a richly saturated RED folded material against deep near-black, a small bright cyan reflected edge, more scarlet than orange or pink. All UI backgrounds below use the exact specified EXISTING Cyberdream dark palette: base #16181A, elevated #1E2124, selection/raised detail #3C4048, primary text #FFFFFF and secondary readable gray #7B8496. Official CYBERDREAM cyan #5EF1FF on sliders, small links, focus details and selected secondary controls. Syntax may use small amounts of blue #5EA1FF, green #5EFF6C, yellow #F1FF5E, purple #BD5EFF but don't let them become dominant. No default soft pastel Catppuccin appearance, no green/yellow-dominant Gruvbox, no predominantly blue background. Prefer crisp neutral-charcoal surfaces with saturated red and cyan. Replace any terminal fetch/system hardware/version claims with a simple illustrative shell listing in ~/.dotfiles and a theme label. Main code editor stays realistically populated with a short syntax-highlighted code excerpt; no invented implementation claims. Preserve the rest of the source composition. High fidelity landscape straight-on screenshot, approximately 16:10.
STOCK CYBERDREAM PALETTE: use the upstream red #FF6E5E for all active red controls, selection highlights, media progress and window-focus indication. This red is bright warm red/coral, never muted dusty rose; retain high saturation. Wallpaper is deep scarlet with red/coral folds, echoing the palette while retaining the original red atmosphere. Cyan #5EF1FF remains bright and icy. The shell palette is a proposed translation of upstream colors. Do not turn the controls pink. Terminal's tiny theme label says 'cyberdream'. This must visibly feel very close to the original custom red/cyan screenshot.
